description: This Java class defines a composite implementation of ConnectivityCommandInterceptor that aggregates multiple interceptors and executes them all on a given connectivity command.

classes.name: CompoundConnectivityCommandInterceptor
classes.description: A final class that implements ConnectivityCommandInterceptor, aggregating multiple such interceptors and executing all on a command.

methods.name: CompoundConnectivityCommandInterceptor
methods.description: Constructor that takes a variable number of ConnectivityCommandInterceptor instances and stores them as a collection.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Overrides the accept method to execute all contained interceptors on the given command and connection supplier.
